summary:
EARTH SYMPHONY – Listen to the Heartbeat of Our Planet

Earth Symphony is an interactive educational project created by POWER OF THE SPACE for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, inspired by the Earth Information Jukebox challenge.

Our project aims to transform Earth's environmental information into sound, allowing people to experience our planet in a new and creative way. By exploring oceans, the atmosphere, and vegetation, users can discover how environmental changes can be represented through musical frequencies, rhythms, and sound intensity.

Our interactive prototype allows users to select an Earth system, adjust parameters, and listen to generated sounds that illustrate the relationship between environmental values and audio.

Through the combination of science, technology, music, and education, we aim to make Earth science more accessible, engaging, and understandable, while raising awareness about our planet.

Our mission is simple: Don't just look at Earth. Listen to it.
details:
Earth Symphony is an interactive educational project that transforms environmental information about our planet into sound.

The project focuses on three important Earth systems: oceans, the atmosphere, and vegetation. Instead of only looking at environmental information through maps, graphs, and numbers, users can explore it through sound.

Our prototype allows users to select an Earth system and adjust different parameters using interactive controls. These values are then translated into audio characteristics such as pitch, volume, and rhythm.

For example, changing a temperature or intensity value can change the frequency or volume of the generated sound. This creates an audio experience that helps users explore how environmental conditions can be represented in a different way.

Our current prototype uses illustrative values and generated sounds to demonstrate this concept. It is designed so that real, verified NASA Earth data could be integrated in a future version.
